author: OmegaZ666
quote:
Wow. How bad can it be?
Would have wished for more RDR2 in this game, and I dont mean the building mechanics. I am talking about the Trevor Phillips esque non stop brutality **** life, not this lifestyle hipster gangsters. 

A game without comedy. Just not humourous. I dont want to hear about a mental state that is really not that bad, I want to hear something f-ed up, that I will never hear in real life. 

I love driving, but not in this game. 
No realism, no pseudo-realism, every car has 500+ hp out the box and weighs nothing. 
Crashing in to a truck, you push the truck back like a pool ball, no reprocussions. I want to be scolded for bad driving skills, in the past that ment taking a car with bad driving characteristics, a Blista Compact or just a Sabre, and really getting used to it. The first real car, the vapid, already drives like a hypercar...
 
Sad. Bad. Tragedy.
